source: In many ZXNAME0000XZ weight-only kernels, packed low-bit weights are read from memory, unpacked/dequantized inside the kernel, and multiplied with higher-precision activations. The memory traffic is low-bit even though the arithmetic path is not “ZXNAME0001XZ everywhere.”
zh: 在许多 ZXNAME0000XZ 仅权重内核中，从内存中读取打包的低位权重，在内核内部解包/反量化，并与更高精度的激活相乘。即使算术路径不是“到处都是 ZXNAME0001XZ”，内存流量也是低位的。
